nodes.label: Preliminary FastChem HCN refit and database discrepancy follow-up

model.name: Preliminary FastChem HCN refit and database discrepancy follow-up
model.description:
Why did preliminary FastChem HCN predictions differ from ExoGibbs curated, how much did the HCN refit change them, and what remains unexplained?

### Compared HCN inputs

| Input | HCN representation and source |
| --- | --- |
| FastChem preliminary tables | Previous and revised HCN formation-Kp fits. The 2026-10-27 producer report describes a Goos/Burcat-based refit; the exact source snapshot and fitting recipe have not been independently reconstructed. This is a preliminary update, not an adopted release. [Producer report](#evidence/producer_report). |
| ExoGibbs curated-gas-v1 | HCN (not HNC): CEA thermal functions with an ATcT 1.172 balanced atomization-energy anchor; Hf(298 K) = 129.293 kJ/mol. This pinned curated dataset is the comparison baseline, not an assumed physical truth. [Source audit](#evidence/source_audit). |

All abundance calculations use the **same ExoGibbs solver**, 537-species network and normalized Asplund 2021 composition. The comparison changes thermochemical inputs, not solver implementations; formation Kp is dimensionless at a 1-bar standard pressure.

### Recorded discrepancy

At the same 2500 K, 0.01 bar sample on the inverted profile (differences relative to curated):

| Quantity | Previous preliminary / curated | Revised preliminary / curated |
| --- | --- | --- |
| HCN formation Kp at 2500 K | 0.753006 (-24.70%) | 0.967363 (-3.26%) |
| HCN mole fraction at 2500 K, 0.01 bar | 0.744527 (-25.55%) | 0.956471 (-4.35%) |

The remaining abundance difference includes coupled atomic abundances, not only the HCN formation constant. The largest absolute log-ratio deviations for revised/curated are -4.38% at 4000 K, 100 bar (isothermal) and -4.67% at 3400 K, 39.8107 bar (inverted). These extrema cover only the two recorded 161-layer profiles and points with mole fraction at least 1e-12 in either table. [Comparison execution and pinned numerical summary](#evidence/comparison_execution).

### Sources and unresolved questions

- **Source identity and fit:** the producer cites Goos/Burcat. An inspected public Burcat HCN entry uses Hf(298 K) = 129.799 kJ/mol, 0.506 kJ/mol above the curated ATcT anchor, but this public copy is not established as the producer's actual input. [Producer report](#evidence/producer_report) and [Burcat / ATcT source audit](#evidence/source_audit).
- **Cause of the residual:** the energy-anchor difference is a candidate contribution. The exact source version, atomic references, thermal functions, fit interval and weights must be reconstructed before attributing the residual. [Source audit](#evidence/source_audit).
- **Physical accuracy:** closer database agreement is not independent physical validation or a calibrated uncertainty. Whole-mixture accuracy and retrieval effects remain unknown; no spectrum or retrieval was run. [Recorded comparison scope](#evidence/comparison_execution).

record.summary: Revised preliminary FastChem / curated HCN mole-fraction differences at the largest absolute log-ratio points on each sampled profile: isothermal: -4.38% at 4000 K and 100 bar; inverted: -4.67% at 3400 K and 39.8107 bar. Two 161-layer profiles from #284/#298; fixed 537-species network and solar budget. Only standard logK.dat solved; other archives audited. No spectra or retrieval. Normalized Asplund 2021 composition; the same ExoGibbs solver for all tables. Extrema include only points with mole fraction >=1e-12 in either table. Differences include coupled atomic abundances. These are recorded model sensitivities, not accuracy rankings, error bounds or a calibrated uncertainty distribution. Your conditions have not been evaluated.

A versioned source-adoption model, not a whole-mixture physical validation. Unreviewed species retain their pinned FastChem fits. Atomic translation uses unit heavy-particle mass ratios and electron spin two, as in the approved audit. Partition fit terms are numerical basis functions, not measured new levels.
